Aisha (CS): Heads-up — Brightline reported a sharp drop in top-k relevancy since our 4-bit quant rollout last week. They say search answers are 'off' for product recommendations. They have screenshots and a small eval set. Attaching minimal repro in a sec.
Tom (AE): This is high-ARR customer (>$2M), Dedicated deployment. CSM has escalated. @Priya can you advise priority/next steps?
Priya (PM): Thanks. Two quick asks: paste 3 representative queries + expected vs returned; and include model name, quant_profile and embed hash if available. We need to decide hotfix vs backlog. Proposed acceptance criteria: restore top-1 precision to within 2% of baseline OR MRR delta <= 4% on their 10k sample. If we can't meet that in 72h, CS may request credits.
Liam (ML Eng): My initial hypothesis: quantization-induced embedding drift. Quick checks: compare cosine-sim distribution pre/post and run eval on the customer's sample. If it's the quant profile, a rollback to previous profile is the fastest mitigation. Longer-term fixes: re-embed with 8-bit or change model. Need model sha, tokenizer version, quant config, and a sample of their vectors.
Aisha (CS): Sample (3 queries pasted here):
1) 'best noise-cancelling headphones under $200' -> expected: 'QuietPro Q1, SoundLeaf S2' -> returned: 'wireless earbuds generic'
2) 'kids educational board games 6-8' -> expected: 'AlphaLearn Board, STEM Buddies' -> returned: 'puzzle sets'
3) 'ergonomic office chair assembly guide' -> expected: 'EO Chair manual pdf' -> returned: 'office furniture list'
I'll attach a CSV with 500 labeled pairs to the ticket.
Aisha (CS): Debug command we used: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/debug/embeddings?customer=brightline` — returns embedding metadata including `model`, `quant_profile`, `vector_id`, and `created_at`. Please use that to pull vectors.
Priya (PM): Proposal for scope: (1) Hotfix: rollback quant profile for Brightline in Dedicated (SLA target: 24–48h) if rollback restores metrics. (2) Medium: re-embed dataset with 8-bit quant profile + run full regression suite (2–3 weeks). (3) Long: consider model replacement / fine-tune if quality still bad. Need eng estimate for rollback risk and time, and cost delta for 8-bit re-embed.
Liam (ML Eng): Quick offline check on a small holdout (n=1k) shows avg cos-sim drop 0.67 -> 0.53 after quant rollout. That's material. I'll run their 500-sample CSV overnight and post results. If we rollback we must validate memory/latency tradeoffs (8-bit vs 4-bit).
Tom (AE): CS will file the ticket as P1-customer-impact and attach CSV + screenshots. Customer expects interim mitigation or credits if unresolvable within 72h.
Priya (PM): OK. Next steps: Tom file ticket, tag product/embeddings and eng-ml, include acceptance criteria and the sample CSV. I'll triage against other active items this afternoon and come back with target ETA for a hotfix. @Liam please post the overnight run results here.
NotifyBot: Ticket #CS-5873 created by Tom (AE) with tags product/embeddings, eng-ml, urgent. Assigned to Priya (PM).
Aisha (CS): :thumbsup: adding customer contact and availability for a pairing session tomorrow 10am PT.
